messages.author: 26c971075f8aedcc
messages.subject: liblzma.5.dylib problems on MacOSX
parts:
Hi,

I recently encountered an odd system error when using INLA on MacOSX El Captian where R was installed via MacPorts. The error was:

> Fit <- inla(formula=Model, data=x)
dyld: Library not loaded: /opt/local/lib/liblzma.5.dylib
  Referenced from: /opt/local/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/lib/libR.dylib
  Reason: Incompatible library version: libR.dylib requires version 8.0.0 or later, but liblzma.5.dylib provides version 6.0.0
sh: line 1: 27926 Trace/BPT trap: 5       '/Users/ggorjanc/Library/R/3.3/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run' -b -s -v '/var/folders/d2/brkpzf554_n71tww54fqt3b5m9g2_v/T//RtmpT8vwa9/file1e8124541c/Model.ini' > /var/folders/d2/brkpzf554_n71tww54fqt3b5m9g2_v/T//RtmpT8vwa9/file1e8124541c/Logfile.txt
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

I installed R via MacPorts, which also installed liblzma

$ otool -L /opt/local/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/lib/libR.dylib
/opt/local/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/lib/libR.dylib:
...
/opt/local/lib/liblzma.5.dylib (compatibility version 8.0.0, current version 8.2.0)
...

however there is also a system version of the same library

$ otool -L /usr/lib/liblzma.5.dylib 
/usr/lib/liblzma.5.dylib:
/usr/lib/liblzma.5.dylib (compatibility version 6.0.0, current version 6.3.0)
...

and given the error message that inla() call threw it is obvious that the system version has been called. I have not encountered this problem before with other programs and I also did not had the LD_LIBRARY_PATH or DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH variables set. Inspecting a bit further I found out that inla.run script tweaks these two variables as:

export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$RHOME_LIB:$DIR:/usr/lib:$DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH"

changing the 1st line to the following solved the issue:

export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$RHOME_LIB:$DIR:/opt/local/lib:/usr/lib:$DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH"

Regards, Gregor

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] liblzma.5.dylib problems on MacOSX
parts:
Thanks G,

this dylib loading is kind of messy and its required since we now link
with libR. The libs on /usr/lib are sometimes 'old' as you say, hence
it might be an idea to add /opt/local/lib before checking /usr/lib, as
its there is something there its usually installed using macports,
hences the lib-versions are the newer ones and these are usually
backward compatible. 

thank again,
H

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] liblzma.5.dylib problems on MacOSX
parts:
Hi,

Could the library paths in

/usr/local/lib/R/3.4/site-library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run

be changed from

export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$RHOME_LIB:$DIR:$LIBPNGPATH:/usr/lib:/opt/local/lib:$DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH"

to a better default of

export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$RHOME_LIB:$DIR:$LIBPNGPATH:/usr/local/lib:/usr/lib:/opt/local/lib:$DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH"

Thanks!

gg
